categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes parameter validation in interfaces::Mining methods rather than IPC transport, serialization, or connection handling infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Mining interface changes that travel over IPC remain mining-specific unless they alter the core IPC infrastructure.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining implementation methods waitNext and waitTipChanged.
categories.rationale: Prevents debug node aborts and invalid wait deadlines when IPC callers pass negative or NaN timeouts. As the author notes, no known client currently sends these values ('sv2-tp, for example, requires an interval of at least one second'), making this defensive hardening rather than an urgent operational fix.
